principle: A local model is not a tool by itself. This matrix enumerates every tool-like ability a user might EXPECT Peh to perform and records the truth about whether the build ships a real implementation. The application-layer honesty annotator (src/lib/chat/honestyAnnotation.ts) overrides the model's text whenever it implies a tool action that this build cannot perform.
machineReadableSourceOfTruth: This JSON is the machine-readable source of truth for the tool surface. It is consumed by scripts/peh-pub-diagnostic.mjs and the npm run verify:capabilities script. The markdown view (docs/TOOL_MATRIX_PUBLIC_PEH.md) is a human-readable projection. When the two disagree, this JSON wins.

statuses.LOCAL_TOOL_READY: Real local tool is implemented, enabled, and tested. Produces a real tool receipt on success.
statuses.LOCAL_MODEL_ONLY: The capability is answered by the local model's TEXT alone, with no tool action. The model cannot claim a tool action; the honesty annotator overrides such claims.
statuses.LOCAL_PARTIAL: Some local execution exists but is limited or backend-conditional.
statuses.LOCAL_BLOCKED: Local path is reachable but explicitly disabled in this mode.
statuses.DISABLED: Implementation exists in a non-public branch; disabled in public local mode.
statuses.NOT_IMPLEMENTED: No backing route, no implementation, no fetch path, no execution surface.
statuses.CLOUD_REQUIRED_NOT_WIRED: Cloud would be required; no cloud call path is wired.
statuses.CLOUD_REQUIRED_CONSENT_NEEDED: Cloud is required and a consent flow exists, but no cloud SDK is bundled.

canonicalTiers.LOCAL_READY: Implemented, validated, runs locally, no approval needed for the read-only/text path. Beginner-safe.
canonicalTiers.LOCAL_LIMITED: Implemented and runs locally, but bounded by hard scope limits AND explicit per-action approval (file inspection, tiny edits, etc.).
canonicalTiers.LOCAL_PARTIAL: Implemented locally but quality, backend coverage, or model-dependence limits delivery.
canonicalTiers.CLOUD_PLANNED: Architecture exists. No adapter, no call path, no test coverage of a real round trip.
canonicalTiers.NOT_IMPLEMENTED: No code path of any kind. Not blocked by policy, simply not built.
canonicalTiers.BLOCKED: Refused by design; contract-enforced by type system or runtime guards. Not a roadmap item.

canonicalTierMapping.LOCAL_TOOL_READY -> LOCAL_READY or LOCAL: If requiresApproval:true and the tool is approval-gated (file_inspect, tiny_edit), the canonicalTier is LOCAL_LIMITED. Otherwise LOCAL_READY.
canonicalTierMapping.LOCAL_MODEL_ONLY -> LOCAL_PARTIAL: Model-only surfaces are quality-bounded by the installed model.
canonicalTierMapping.NOT_IMPLEMENTED -> NOT_IMPLEMENTED or BL: Dangerous action tools (shell, fs.write/delete, code_execute) are BLOCKED; informational gaps (web_search, document_parse) are NOT_IMPLEMENTED.
canonicalTierMapping.CLOUD_REQUIRED_NOT_WIRED -> CLOUD_PLANNE: All cloud-required entries with no adapter are CLOUD_PLANNED.

honestyAnnotator.behavior: Detects first-person past/present tool-action claims in model replies and emits a user-visible correction. The model's reply text is preserved verbatim; the correction is delivered as a separate field (handler: ChatSuccessBody.honestyMessage, stream: honesty event).

tools.name: Read a file from disk
tools.honestUserMessage: This public local build cannot read arbitrary files from your disk. There is a narrow approval-gated file inspection tool (file_inspect) that reads ONE file at a time with your explicit approval.

tools.name: Write/save a file to disk
tools.proof: src/lib/chat/honestyAnnotation.test.ts ('I wrote the file' → fs.write hallucination), src/lib/toolHonesty.test.ts
tools.honestUserMessage: I can draft the content, but this public local build does not have a general file-write tool. The narrow approval-gated tiny-edit tool can replace one snippet in one already-inspected file (≤4KB diff).

tools.name: Delete a file or folder
tools.proof: src/lib/chat/honestyAnnotation.test.ts ('I deleted the file' → fs.delete hallucination)
tools.honestUserMessage: This public local build cannot delete files. Nothing was removed.

tools.name: Move or rename a file
tools.honestUserMessage: This public local build cannot move or rename files.

tools.name: Receive an uploaded file from the user
tools.proof: src/app/api/oculus/analyze/route.test.ts, src/lib/egressGuard.test.ts (only /api/chat target, no leakage of image data)
tools.honestUserMessage: I can analyze an image you paste/upload through Oculus using a local vision model. The image stays local. I cannot read arbitrary files from your disk.

tools.name: Parse PDF / DOCX / spreadsheet
tools.proof: no PDF/DOCX parser dependency; static dep audit in scripts/peh-pub-diagnostic.mjs
tools.honestUserMessage: I can only work with text that has already been provided. This build does not include a local PDF/DOCX/spreadsheet parser.

tools.name: Analyze image with local vision model (Oculus)
tools.proof: src/app/api/oculus/analyze/route.test.ts, src/lib/oculus/helpers.test.ts; only Ollama vision; llama-cpp explicitly blocked.
tools.honestUserMessage: Oculus can analyze an image you select, but it needs a local vision model. Ollama is supported; llama-server vision is not.

tools.name: Execute a shell command
tools.proof: honestyAnnotation.test.ts ('I ran the tests'), publicReleaseSafety.test.ts (no tool fields sent), src/lib/planning/planner.test.ts (shell intent → blocked)
tools.honestUserMessage: I cannot run shell commands in this public local build. I can suggest a command for you to run manually.

tools.name: Execute arbitrary code
tools.honestUserMessage: I cannot execute code on your machine. I can explain what the code would do.

tools.name: Single-file code-suggestion workshop (Fabrica)
tools.honestUserMessage: Fabrica produces a single-file SUGGESTION using the local model. It does not save the file or apply the change — you copy the suggestion yourself.

tools.name: Multi-file repo editing
tools.honestUserMessage: Multi-file builds would require a future Cloud Agent mode. This build does not call cloud.

tools.name: Inspect repository / project files (broad)
tools.supersededBy: file_inspect (narrow, one file at a time, approval-gated)
tools.honestUserMessage: I cannot inspect your repository broadly. There is a narrow approval-gated tool (file_inspect) that reads ONE file at a time with your explicit approval.

tools.name: Local file search (grep)
tools.honestUserMessage: I do not have a local file-search tool. Paste relevant text and I can answer from it.

tools.name: Web search
tools.proof: honestyAnnotation.test.ts ('I searched the web'); egressGuard.test.ts (no remote fetch)
tools.honestUserMessage: I do not have a local web/search tool, and cloud is locked in this build. I can answer from the local model's knowledge only.

tools.name: Browse / fetch a URL
tools.honestUserMessage: I do not have a local browser tool. No URL was fetched.

tools.name: Long-term memory write
tools.route: (none — note storage is browser-only via Archivum)
tools.honestUserMessage: I do not have a long-term memory tool. To remember something across sessions, save it as an Archivum note manually.

tools.name: Browser-local notes (Archivum)
tools.honestUserMessage: Archivum saves notes only in this browser's localStorage. It does not write to disk or sync anywhere.

tools.name: List local models
tools.honestUserMessage: Peh lists models from your local model server only — never from a cloud catalog.

tools.name: Local model health probe
tools.honestUserMessage: Peh pings your configured local model server only.

tools.name: Read browser-local receipts
tools.honestUserMessage: Tabularium reads receipts from this browser only.

tools.name: Capability map / Nous
tools.honestUserMessage: Nous is a static read of the capability matrix and model preferences. No call out.

tools.name: Release-readiness diagnostic
tools.honestUserMessage: Developer tool — verifies the local-first contract; not a user-facing capability.

tools.name: Local-model heuristic smoke (gauntlet)
tools.honestUserMessage: Heuristic local-model smoke. PASS / TRY_VERIFY / NEEDS_CLOUD / BLOCKED are distinct. Not a formal safety proof.

tools.name: Send an email
tools.proof: honestyAnnotation.test.ts ('I sent the email' is not in current pattern set but other tests cover the principle)
tools.honestUserMessage: I do not have an email-sending tool. The bug-report flow opens your email client with a prefilled message; you send it yourself.

tools.name: Git commit / push / merge
tools.honestUserMessage: I cannot touch git. No commit, push, or merge happened.

tools.name: Install / uninstall a package
tools.honestUserMessage: I cannot install or remove packages on your machine.

tools.name: Approval-gated single-file inspection (read-only, ≤256 KB)
tools.route: (in-process via /api/chat inspection intent; no dedicated route)
tools.honestUserMessage: Peh reads one file at a time, only after you approve the exact path. Approval expires in ten minutes and is bound to that file — it cannot be reused for another file. Secrets are redacted before they reach the model.

tools.name: Approval-gated tiny edit (single snippet, ≤4 KB diff, rollback on verify-fail)
tools.route: (in-process via /api/chat edit intent; no dedicated route)
tools.proof: src/lib/editing/apply.test.ts, src/lib/editing/approval.test.ts, src/lib/editing/safety.test.ts, src/lib/editing/verifier.test.ts, src/lib/editing/diff.test.ts, src/lib/editing/types.test.ts, src/lib/chat/editIntent.test.ts, src/lib/chat/editingChat.test.ts
tools.receiptCoverage: yes (editing.proposed, editing.approval-requested, editing.approved, editing.applied, editing.verified, editing.rollback-started, editing.rollback-completed)
tools.honestUserMessage: Peh can replace ONE exact snippet in ONE already-inspected file (≤4 KB diff) — only after you approve the diff. A backup is kept in memory; if verification fails after the write, Peh rolls back automatically. No mkdir, no unlink, no rename, no exec.

tools.name: Structured planning + provenance (deterministic; no execution)
tools.honestUserMessage: Peh can describe HOW she would approach a task with explicit evidence labels (known, inferred, assumed, missing) and a confidence level. The planner never executes — it only describes.

tools.name: Small-model reliability layer (bounded compound tools)
tools.honestUserMessage: For complicated questions on a small local model, Peh plans a short sequence of safe compound tools (explain project structure, inspect one file, summarise an error, run a health check) — max 6 steps, max 2 retries. Cloud escalation may be suggested but never auto-run.

tools.name: Local teacher Q&A (deterministic concept answers)
tools.honestUserMessage: Beginner questions about AI, models, cloud, tools, approvals, and Peh herself are answered deterministically from the concept registry. No model call is required for known concepts.

tools.name: Honesty correction (hallucinated tool-action detector)
tools.route: applied in /api/chat handler and stream route
tools.receiptCoverage: annotated on chat receipt; no separate receipt action
tools.honestUserMessage: When the model claims to have done a tool action this build cannot perform, Peh adds a correction note explaining what really happened (or did not happen).

tools.name: Provenance footer on every reply
tools.route: applied in /api/chat handler and stream route
tools.proof: src/lib/publicReleaseSafety.test.ts (cloudUsed/toolsUsed forced false), scripts/peh-pub-diagnostic.mjs (provenance copy grep)
tools.honestUserMessage: Every reply tells you where it came from: 'answered by local model only · no tool used · no cloud used'. cloudUsed and toolsUsed are literal types in the response shape — they cannot be flipped at runtime.
